column1: # Altin flood: villagers, shops, mine damage, recovery, western route, and Feizhi's passage. Preserve story flags and original end codes.

column3: Is this your first\nvisit to Altin?{end_now}
Where does all that\nwater come from?\nIt never stops.{end_wait}
The flood ruined\neverything I own.{page_break}The walls are soaked\nthrough.{end_wait}
The mine is flooded.\nNo one can work\ndown there.{end_wait}
Kill the water beasts\nand the flood may end.{page_break}It's our only hope.{end_wait}
We used to pray\nfor rain in Altin.{page_break}Now we're praying\nfor dry ground.{end_wait}
That water smells foul.\nDon't drink it.{page_break}We've already had\npeople fall ill.{end_wait}
The water is falling.{page_break}Maybe the old shafts\nare draining it away.{end_wait}
Those beasts looked\nlike the statues\nin our mine.{page_break}What woke them?{end_wait}
The flood washed\nloose tons of rock.{page_break}There may be ore\nunder all that mud.{end_wait}
You've come at\na terrible time.{page_break}We barely have\nroom for ourselves.{end_wait}
It's as though\nthe beasts draw water\nfrom the air.{end_wait}
I saved one letter.\nEverything else\nwashed away.{end_wait}
Even our strongest\nminers can't work\nin this flood.{end_wait}
If the water rises\nany higher, Altin\nwill disappear.{end_wait}
Water keeps us alive.\nToo much of it\ncan kill us.{end_wait}
The water stinks.\nIt's soaking into\nevery floorboard.{end_wait}
Each beast we defeat\nleaves less water\nin the streets.{end_wait}
The guardian statue\nwas pouring water.{page_break}I saw it myself.{end_wait}
I don't want\nany more relics.{page_break}Look what the last\nones brought us.{end_wait}
The house is ruined.\nI don't know where\nwe'll sleep.{end_wait}
It will take months\nto repair this house.{page_break}We have to start\nsomewhere.{end_wait}
Keep your guard up.\nOne strike won't\nend every fight.{end_wait}
Are you trying\nto cross the mountains\nto the west?{end_now}
Those creatures\nwere dangerous.{page_break}Still, I wonder\nwhat made them attack.{end_wait}
I thought Altin\nwas finished.{page_break}We survived.\nThat's enough for now.{end_wait}
My home is still here.\nI can rebuild\nwhat the flood took.{end_wait}
I couldn't bear\nto abandon Altin.{page_break}I came back\nas soon as I could.{end_wait}
I heard the beasts\nwere gone, so I returned.{page_break}I wanted to see\nmy home again.{end_wait}
The eastern shaft...\nI know there's\nsomething down there.{end_wait}
My husband knows\nwhere the good ore lies.{page_break}He'll return\nwhen it's safe.{end_wait}
Mom and Pop know\nsomething about\nthe deep mine.{page_break}They won't tell me.{end_wait}
The water's gone.\nI can finally\nopen the shop.{end_wait}
I thought my shop\nwould sink beneath\nthe water.{end_wait}
The doors are open.\nI never thought\nI'd see that again.{end_wait}
My armor is underwater.\nI can't sell\na single piece.{end_wait}
We cleaned the shop.\nI can sell armor\nagain.{end_wait}
The armor is rusting\non its racks.{page_break}I'll lose everything\nif it stays wet.{end_wait}
We dried every piece\nand polished the metal.{page_break}Some of it\ncan still be sold.{end_wait}
If the water reaches\nmy goods, I'm ruined.{end_wait}
My stock survived.\nI can keep\nthe shop open.{end_wait}
I'll have to dry\neverything before\nI can sell it.{end_wait}
A few things got wet.\nI checked them all.{page_break}They're still fit\nfor use.{end_wait}
I came from Xian.\nNow I cook here.{page_break}Come in. There's\nfood enough today.{end_wait}
No one can go home\nuntil the streets\nare clear.{end_wait}
The guests in room one\nwent home when\nthe flood receded.{end_wait}
Room two is empty.\nThey've finally\nreturned home.{end_wait}
We'll survive this.\nI'm less certain\nabout the village.{end_wait}
I learned to cook\nafter coming here.{page_break}People need\na warm meal.{end_wait}
Most of Altin\nis still underwater.{page_break}Rebuilding will\ntake a long time.{end_wait}
The water has fallen,\nbut the damage remains.{page_break}We'll need months\nto recover.{end_wait}
I was born in Altin.\nI'm not leaving\nit behind.{end_wait}
Our house is ruined.{page_break}I don't know\nif we can stay.{end_wait}
Tolbi is far away.\nWe can't just\nleave everything.{end_wait}
Perhaps I should\nmove to Tolbi.{page_break}There's little\nleft for me here.{end_wait}
Few travelers come\nthis way now.{page_break}Are the roads\nstill passable?{end_wait}
The flood stopped\nmy chores.{page_break}Now there's twice\nas much to do.{end_wait}
The western passage\nleads through\nthe mountains.{end_wait}
I can't bear\nwaiting here.{page_break}I want to go home.{end_wait}
Please help\nthe people of Altin.\nThey have nowhere to go.{end_wait}
Thank you for\ndefeating the beasts\nin the mine.{end_wait}
Once the mine opens,\nwe can earn\na living again.{end_wait}
Work has resumed\nin the upper shafts.{page_break}No one wants\nto go deeper.{end_wait}
The mine drained\nthrough its cracks.{page_break}The remaining water\nmay weaken the rock.{end_wait}
The streets are dry.\nThank the heavens.{page_break}Now we face\nthe rebuilding.{end_wait}
I heard our rescuers\nwere young.{page_break}I'd like to thank\nthem myself.{end_wait}
The beasts are gone.\nThe damage isn't.{page_break}We still have\nso much to repair.{end_wait}
The old statues\nreally became beasts.{page_break}What happened\nbeneath that mountain?{end_wait}
We can return\nto the mines.{page_break}I'll be glad\nto work again.{end_wait}
I feared the beasts\nwould release\neven more water.{end_wait}
I hope the mine\nrecovers.{page_break}Altin depends\non its work.{end_wait}
The rock is soaked.\nIt may crumble\nunder our feet.{end_wait}
The mine walls\nare still wet.{page_break}The air is thick\nand hard to breathe.{end_wait}
That chamber\nbelow the mine\nshould stay sealed.{end_wait}
You fought those\nbeasts in filthy water.{page_break}I don't know\nhow you managed.{end_wait}
The shafts are full\nof cracks and holes.{page_break}That's how\nthe water escaped.{end_wait}
The guardian statues\nalways frightened me.{page_break}Now I know why.{end_wait}
I used to find\nold objects in the ore.{page_break}Perhaps they came\nfrom those ruins.{end_wait}
A girl from Xian\nsaid Silk Road\nwas blocked.{end_wait}

A girl from Xian
asked about
young warriors.{page_break}Was she looking
for you?{end_now}
The road is blocked.\nOur merchants\ncan't get through.{end_wait}
That girl from Xian\nseemed desperate.{page_break}I wonder who\nshe was seeking.{end_wait}
I used to wish\nthe beasts would go.{page_break}Now the mine\nfeels strangely quiet.{end_wait}
Those beasts\nwere terrifying.{page_break}I still wonder\nwhere they came from.{end_wait}
Ancient ruins\nbeneath the mine?{page_break}How long have\nthey been there?{end_wait}

If there's treasure
down there,
leave it alone.{page_break}We've lost enough
for one season.{end_wait}
There may be treasure\nin the old chamber.{page_break}But I won't risk\nanother collapse.{end_wait}
I never knew\nthere were ruins\nbeneath Altin.{end_wait}
Did Mom and Pop\nknow about\nthat monument?{end_wait}
The road is blocked.{page_break}Try the passage\nthrough the mine.{end_wait}

I've heard of
a western passage
inside the mine.{page_break}I've never seen
it myself.{end_wait}
Our armor survived\nthe flood.{page_break}Take a look\nif you need any.{end_wait}
If you like it,\nplease buy it.{page_break}We need the business.{end_wait}
The girl from Xian\nbought supplies.{page_break}She looked ready\nfor a long journey.{end_wait}
The girl from Xian\nbought what she could.{page_break}I hope it helps\nher on the road.{end_wait}
There's a temple\nwest of the mine.{page_break}They may have\nheard of the flood.{end_wait}
The desert lies\nbeyond the mountains.{page_break}Carry plenty\nof water.{end_wait}
The western desert\nis brutally hot.{page_break}Travel prepared\nor don't go.{end_wait}
The western temple\nis called Lama Temple.{page_break}Its monks study\nunusual powers.{end_wait}
Silk Road is blocked.\nYou can't reach\nthe desert that way.{end_wait}
No one can travel\nwest by Silk Road\nright now.{end_wait}
Altin will recover,\nbut not quickly.{page_break}People have lost\ntoo much.{end_wait}
